critical_code_review_comments: FreePreviewLanding.jsx cinematic-score countup relies on backend teaser.overall_potential being non-null; teaser is REGENERATED server-side from full_report.scores (server.py L6699-6705). Free-preview reports created BEFORE full_report exists will render the locked '84 blurred' state and the cinematic will show only the end line — no score countup. Consider seeding teaser.overall_potential directly (or having preview pipeline compute it) so free-preview cinematic reliably shows the 84/100 countup even before full_report exists.

Server does not honour a stored teaser value on the report doc — it always overwrites it in the /api/reports/{id} response. If product wants free-preview to have a real 0-100 estimate before purchase, the backend needs a code change.
